content.text:
I couldn't find out what workout you have planned for tomorrow (Thursday, 19 March). Your Garmin connection uses a Personal API key, and that kind of key doesn't give access to your training calendar. So I can't tell whether you have something planned or not.

To check, you can:
- Open the **Garmin Connect app → Calendar** (or **Training & Planning → Training Plans** if you're on a Garmin Coach plan or adaptive plan).
- Look at your **watch**: the workout often shows up in your morning report or under Training → Workouts or Calendar.

The same key limit also blocks your Training Readiness and training status. If you tell me what the workout is, I can still help you prepare, for example by looking at how you've been sleeping, your HRV or your recent training.
